note: Addressable LEDs for calc led_strip. Values from the datasheets in data/sources/mod-pixel.json; 'evidence' quotes a line of tests/corpus/excerpts/mod-pixel-*.txt. kind addressable_led: i_channel is the per-colour current of a datasheet test condition (basis 'test_condition'), not a guaranteed maximum. APA102C: image-only class B datasheet, every value verified false (read from the page images). i_planning (WS2812B, APA102C only): a second, larger per-pixel current at full white from a vendor guide of class B (basis 'rule_of_thumb', verified false, not a datasheet value); 'quote' is a sentence of tests/corpus/excerpts/pixel-planning-*.txt. No source names the SK6812, so it has no planning value.
